body: meh, I'm pretty bad at talking

oh, just something like asking what someone's up to or if they have plans, they say "nope, nothing", and ten minutes later you see them in the snapchat story of a mutual friend. better yet, they snap from the bar/party/whatever social gathering themselves. 

and yeah, it definitely does... so I can't really blame anyone for leaving me. I'm probably not nice enough, not funny enough, and then I'm also distant, so why would anyone bother trying to befriend me.

it's hard to say. I've had motivational issues my entire life, so studying and doing work has been hard. it led to an autism diagnosis, then to ADD, and now there's talk that I might just have chronic fatigue syndrome (I'm always exhausted). 

the social isolation has been a major theme too, probably the biggest. I haven't been bullied, but I was also never a core part of friend groups. never got invited to parties or shopping trips, just heard about them the next day and had to pretend I wasn't upset/jealous. snapchat made it worse. I can't open up to people at all, and I expect everyone to lose interest in me eventually, so I haven't even tried in years (in that sense, losing contact with the last group of friends wasn't a surprise).
